name: signal-clone
description: Secure messaging platform (Signal clone): FastAPI backend, Next.js PWA frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:api: cd backend && uv run mypy app
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.check:pg: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_postgres.py
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:redis: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_redis_fanout.py
scripts.gen:openapi: cd backend && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.gen:client: npm run gen:openapi && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
scripts.check:ui: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_ui.py
scripts.check:shell: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_shell.py
scripts.check:realtime: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_realtime_ui.py
scripts.check:groups: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_groups_ui.py
scripts.check:bonus: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_bonus_ui.py
scripts.check:attachments: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_attachments_ui.py
scripts.check:pwa: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_pwa.py
scripts.icons: cd backend && uv run python scripts/make_icons.py
scripts.check:litestream: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_litestream.py
